text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало returns from her debut race
exhausted
and out of breath, but
overjoyed to now be able
to race
professionally.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The mood is soon dampened when she
receives a
phone call from her
disapproving mother. Judging
by the
tense conversation, it's clear a deep

discord rests between them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But her mother's words do not sway
King's resolve
to prove her wrong.
Determined, she declares her
intent to
win the G1 Hopeful Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
